intro: A glass of green apple juice from a stall is about 150 kcal (estimate). The calories come from the apple's natural sugar and the sugar syrup that's usually added.
diet: Yes, but don't treat juice the same as eating fruit. Juicing removes a lot of the fibre, and it's easy to drink several fruits at once. The no-sugar version is better. If you're watching calories, eating one whole apple is more filling.
tips: Ask for 'tak nak gula'. Green apple already tastes sweet-sour.
Mix with carrot or cucumber to cut the sugar.
Drink it with a meal, not as a separate snack.

swap.name: 1 whole green apple (eaten)
swap.why: Full fibre, more filling, and almost half the calories.

faq.q: Green apple or red apple juice, which is better?
faq.a: Both are okay. Green apples are usually a bit less sweet, so many people like them for juice.

faq.q: Can I drink apple juice on an empty stomach?
faq.a: Some people get a sore stomach because it's sour. If you're sensitive, drink it after eating.

faq.q: Why does apple juice turn brown so fast?
faq.a: Apple oxidises when exposed to air. A little squeeze of lemon can slow this down.
